$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — LLM commander DUEL (DESIGN_LLM_Commander §8, §11 L-4 pre-test; STATUS_Backend_LLM_Commander.md §Duel): llm-platoon-attack with Red under a seat too — Blue's Platoon over Alpha Squad and Bravo Squad, Red Platoon over the Defenders (at the sheds) and Reserve. The rows judge the PLUMBING of two seats on opposite sides — each side's squads report to their OWN commander, never the other's; both sides fight; the fight lasts — not who wins (two copies of one model say little about either). The model logs (commander-<id>.jsonl, one per seat) carry the rest. FEATURE scenario, no golden: a model run is not repeatable. ⚠ One name per by: a LIST in by/who/target is read as 'anyone' by the checks grammar (TakeJson.Name — CE-3502), so the cross-side 'never' rows are one per squad; the 'Blue still fires' row keeps llm-platoon-attack's list and is as weak as it (any shooter) until CE-3502.
